note: Louisa County Conservation park on the Mississippi River bottoms about 10 mi east of Grandview, with a natural wetland and a river boat ramp. The camping loop sits between the wetland and the levee road; the river is over the levee, not in view from the sites. Low-lying ground, so high water can close it; call ahead in spring. --Claude
summary: Count 24 -> 17 (county page), pull-through and water confirmed, 14-night limit added; Flaming Prairie is the one Louisa campground NOT reserved online. No rate, amperage or season posted. Not waterfront confirmed. Pin ~870 m off.
flags: PIN (~870 m off): stored 41.27000,-91.11800 is in woods north of the park; the camping loop is at about 41.2626,-91.1152 (Google's place pin 41.26190,-91.11705 is the park entrance, ~200 m SW of the loop).

NO RATE posted: neither the park page nor the county's MyCountyParks pages publish a camping fee (the rules point to an 'official fee schedule' that is not posted), and no rate is stored. Price stays unresearched from the operator; RV Life price_tier 1 is the only price signal.

BOOKING unclear: the county rules (updated 9/14/2026) exempt Flaming Prairie's campsites from the online-only rule and MyCountyParks lists only its shelter, so the sites cannot be booked online; whether they are first come or taken by phone is not stated. reservable/fcfs left unset.

HOOKUPS: electric 50 (stored, from note prose) is not supported by the page, which says only 'Electricity'; left as derived. The old note's '20/30/50A' and '~24 electric sites' have no source on the operator's pages.
SEASON: year_round true (stored, from note prose) is not stated on any Flaming Prairie page; only the water season (April 1 - Oct 15) is. Left as derived.
FACILITIES: vault_toilets (stored, note prose) is unconfirmed: the page lists just 'Restroom'. Left as derived.

WATERFRONT confirmed not waterfront: on NAIP the loop sits west of the levee road with the levee and a treed strip between it and the Mississippi (~100 m); the wetland to the west is a ~1 ha marsh pond behind a tree belt. Overpass was down (imagery estimates).
FIT unclear: pads are gravel with 'some pull through' and the page stresses room for boat trailers, but no lengths are posted. Keep.
Phone (319) 523-8381 and website confirmed. Google 3.9 from 14 reviews.
